annotations.title: Turn on auto-reorder for an item

description: Tell the platform to watch one item and suggest reordering it when stock runs low: below lowStockPoint, suggest ordering reorderQuantity from this supplier. Calling it again on the same item replaces the rule rather than adding a second one. The supplier MUST already carry this item (get_supplier_items) — otherwise the rule would draft orders to a supplier that cannot fulfil them, and it is refused. The thresholds apply company-wide unless you pass outletOverrides, which set a different point or quantity per outlet — a busy store may need a higher one than a quiet one. This only produces SUGGESTIONS. Nothing is ever ordered or emailed automatically.

lowStockPoint.description: Suggest reordering once stock falls below this

outletOverrides.description: Per-outlet thresholds for outlets that differ from the default

lowStockPoint.description: Omit to inherit the company-wide point

reorderQuantity.description: Omit to inherit the company-wide quantity

supplierId.description: Supplier to reorder from — must already carry this item
